help.title: How to use
help.connect1: Devices on the same Wi-Fi connect automatically as soon as they open this page.
help.connect2: On a phone, scan the QR code on the PC screen with the camera, or type clipboardapp.org in the address bar.
help.connect3: To connect a device on a different Wi-Fi or on mobile data, make a room. Create a new room from '＋ Room' and bring in the other device with a QR code, pictures, or a link. An invite QR code works for 10 minutes.
help.connect4: On the new device, tap 'Join with pictures' and tap the 4 pictures shown on a device in the room, in order. Someone on that device has to tap 'Let in' before you can join.
help.connect5: Tap 'Connect' on a device card to open a room just for the two of you. You connect after checking that both screens show the same picture.
help.connect6: To check that you're connected, look at the animal name on the 'Me' card on the other device's screen and find that name in your list.
help.connect7: When many devices are in Everyone, only the most recent ones are shown. Use 'Find a device' and pick the other device's animal name.
help.send1: Paste copied text or images anywhere on the page with Ctrl+V (⌘+V on Mac) and they are sent right away.
help.send2: For files, tap 'Choose files' or drag them onto the page.
help.send3: Text you type in the box is sent with 'Share' or Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on Mac).
help.send4: Each file can be up to 5GB, and uploads continue where they left off if the connection drops.
help.send5: On iPhone and iPad, add the shortcut to send straight from the Share button in the Photos app.
help.receive1: Tap 'Receive' to download a file, and 'Copy' to copy text to the clipboard.
help.receive2: For several files, check them and tap 'Download' to get one ZIP. Files over 200MB are downloaded separately.
help.receive3: Choose 'Share via QR code' in a file's ⋯ menu, then scan it with another device's camera to get that file. Images can also be copied from the same menu.
help.who1: Same network: visible to devices on the same internet connection. At schools, offices, and cafés, strangers may see it too.
help.who2: Everyone: anyone who has this service open right now can see it.
help.who3: Rooms: only devices in the room can see it, and files and text in a room are encrypted automatically. A room holds up to 10 devices.
help.who4: Lock with a password: set a password of 4 or more characters, and for this visit the files and text you send in that tab are locked on this device before they are sent. Tell the recipient the password separately.
help.who5: The QR code and link of a locked file contain its key, so anyone who has them can get the file without the password. Show them only to the recipient.
help.who6: Animal name tags and device and browser info stay visible even when locked. A name tag tells devices apart; it does not prove who someone is.
help.keep1: Text is kept for 10 minutes, so devices that join in the meantime can still get it.
help.keep2: Text over 96KB is not kept and only reaches devices that are open right now. Send it as a .txt file to keep it for a day.
help.keep3: Files are kept for up to 1 day. They can be removed sooner once every device has left, so download what you need right away.
help.more1: Install the app: open it straight from your home screen, and pick it from other apps' Share button to send files. On Android and PC (Chrome, Edge), use the install icon in the address bar; on iPhone (Safari), tap the Share button and choose 'Add to Home Screen'.
help.more2: Arrival alerts: turn them on in the ⋯ menu to get notified about new files and text even when the tab is in the background.
help.more3: Shortcuts: Ctrl+V paste to send · Ctrl+Enter send typed text · Ctrl+C copy one selected file (⌘ instead of Ctrl on Mac)

seo.title: Online Clipboard – Share Text, Images & Files Between Phone and PC
seo.description: Free online clipboard, no sign-up, no app. Devices on the same Wi-Fi connect automatically in the browser to share copied text, screenshots and files instantly. Deleted when you leave.

landing.headline: The online clipboard between your phone and PC
landing.intro: Clipboard Share is a free online clipboard with no sign-up and no app. Devices on the same Wi-Fi connect automatically in the browser, so copied text, screenshots and files show up on your other device right away.
landing.how1: Open this page on both devices while they are on the same Wi-Fi. Devices on the same network are grouped automatically.
landing.how2: Paste what you want to move (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) or drop a file.
landing.how3: It appears on the other device instantly. Tap once to copy or download.
landing.useCase1: Moving iPhone photos to a Windows PC without a cable
landing.useCase2: Grabbing a file on a shared or office PC without logging into your accounts
landing.useCase3: Sending between Android and Mac when AirDrop is not an option
landing.useCase4: Pasting a long link, one-time code or snippet from your phone into your PC
landing.safety1: The default scope is "Same network", so only devices behind the same public IP can see your items. Sharing with everyone requires switching to the "Everyone" tab yourself.
landing.safety2: When every device leaves, files and text are deleted shortly after, and even while connected, files are cleaned up after at most 1 day. No account, no history.
landing.safety3: Transfers are encrypted with HTTPS and the source code is public on GitHub. With 'Lock with a password' on, files are encrypted on your device before upload, and only people with the password can open them.
landing.faq1a: Yes. Every feature is free and there is no account.
landing.faq2q: Do I need to install an app?
landing.faq2a: No. Any modern browser works: Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox. You can add it to your home screen if you like.
landing.faq3q: Does it work when devices are on different networks?
landing.faq3a: Yes. Tap "＋ Room" → "Create a new room", then scan the invite QR code on the other device or join with the 4 pictures. It works even on different Wi-Fi or mobile data. Files and text you share inside a room are encrypted on your device. The "Everyone" tab also works across networks, but anyone who has the service open can see what you share there, so send sensitive files in a room.
landing.faq4q: Is there a file size limit?
landing.faq4a: Each file can be up to 5GB, and you can upload several files at once.
landing.faq5a: By default, everything is deleted shortly after every device leaves, and even while devices are connected, files are cleaned up within 1 day (cleanup runs periodically, so the exact time is not guaranteed). Download what you need right away. 'Same network' can also be seen by other people on that network, such as at a school or office.
